name: Signal Function Set
_comment: Build script will modify slug/name/version for dev builds to allow coexistence
author: Stuart Frederich-Smith

modules.name: Drift
modules.description: Four phase-shifted LFOs with offset and Lorenz chaos.

modules.name: GSX
modules.description: Granular synthesis after Barry Truax's GSX system.

modules.name: Fugue
modules.description: 8-step harmonic sequencer with three CV/gate voices.

modules.name: Phase
modules.description: Dual sample looper whose two loops drift out of phase.

modules.name: Overtone
modules.description: Additive VCO with eight harmonics you switch on and off.

modules.name: Intone
modules.description: Formant voice after CHANT/FOF, with vowel morphing.

modules.name: Tine
modules.description: Pingable resonator after the Gamelan Resonator circuit.

modules.name: Fugue X
modules.description: Expander for Fugue: per-voice steps, range and sleep.

modules.name: MetaFugue
modules.description: Fugue and Fugue X on one panel, no expander needed.

modules.name: Meter
modules.description: Musical clock with time signatures and per-output swing.

modules.name: Meter X
modules.description: Expander for Meter: 24 PPQN clock and bar triggers.

modules.name: Beat
modules.description: Per-voice drum sequencer with velocity and accent.

modules.name: Note
modules.description: Monophonic CV/gate sequencer with a 12-note pitch matrix.

modules.name: Swell
modules.description: Ping-driven envelope: each ping stacks another rise.

modules.name: Shift
modules.description: Four-lane CV shift register with delay and cascade.

modules.name: Wave
modules.description: Parametric wavetable voice built from eight snapshots.

modules.name: Vac
modules.description: A/R envelope with vactrol-like drift in its timing.

modules.name: Muse
modules.description: Triadex Muse recreation with theme and interval sliders.

modules.name: Gravity
modules.description: Chaos engine: pendulums, gravity wells, turtles and more.

modules.name: Band
modules.description: Four bandpass filters locked to harmonics of one pitch.

modules.name: Cycle
modules.description: Quad LFO locked to the bar, with morphable shapes.

modules.name: Operator
modules.description: DX7-style six-operator FM voice that loads .syx banks.

modules.name: OP ENV
modules.description: A DX7 operator envelope, loaded from .syx, fired by a gate.

modules.name: Chance
modules.description: Generative melody: a seeded walk that strays and returns.

modules.name: Record
modules.description: Auto-sampler: plays a voice and writes WAVs and an .sfz.

modules.name: Play
modules.description: Polyphonic sample player for SFZ and DecentSampler.

modules.name: Ratio
modules.description: Quad VCA: one signal to four outs at their own ratios.

modules.name: Arrange
modules.description: Song-form sequencer: eight phrases with key and tempo.

modules.name: Fill
modules.description: Auto drum sequencer whose pressure builds into fills.

modules.name: Chime
modules.description: Eight-note drone machine with rotating resonator tubes.

modules.name: Crystal
modules.description: 3D echo chamber shaped like a real crystal, quad out.

modules.name: Loom
modules.description: Eight waveguide strings sharing one resonant bridge.

modules.name: Key
modules.description: Quantizer that takes its key and scale from the patch.

modules.name: Slide
modules.description: Electric lap steel: eight strings stopped by a steel bar.

modules.name: OP MORPH
modules.description: Expander for Operator: morph across DX7 routings.

modules.name: SLIDE XP
modules.description: Expander for Slide: each string on its own jacks.

modules.name: Slice
modules.description: Cuts a stream into slices and reverses or stutters them.

modules.name: Kit
modules.description: Eight modal drums: membranes and a two-plate hi-hat.

modules.name: PolyKit In
modules.description: Expander for Kit: every input of every drum as a jack.

modules.name: Field
modules.description: Nineteen random voltages read from one smooth field.

modules.name: Trace
modules.description: A paper loop and four brushes for drawing CVs.

modules.name: Sigma
modules.description: Additive voice of up to 64 partials, morphed by velocity.

modules.name: Touch
modules.description: Articulates a melody: picked, slid, hammered or pedalled.

modules.name: Wheel
modules.description: Hurdy-gurdy drone: one wheel bows six strings at once.

modules.name: Helix
modules.description: Barber-pole phaser whose notches climb without end.

modules.name: Brigade
modules.description: Bucket brigade that moves sound up the spectrum.

modules.name: Spool
modules.description: Four short tapes played by gates, never rewound.

modules.name: Flock
modules.description: A murmuration as a granular voice: birds call in grains.

modules.name: Flock In
modules.description: Expander for Flock: live audio for the birds to sing.

modules.name: Canon
modules.description: Four arpeggiators reading one chord progression.

modules.name: Count
modules.description: A narrow clock: six outputs, each a rate and a mask.

modules.name: Carillon
modules.description: Bells joined by rods: a strike ripples down the set.

modules.name: Strata
modules.description: A wavetable voice you travel through in three dimensions.

modules.name: Cistern
modules.description: Reverb modelled on real rooms, scanned or built from plans.
